steps: Congruent chords GH and KJ in one circle subtend equal minor arcs.
Because J lies on minor arc GH, its measure is arc GJ + arc JH = 83° + t.
Because H lies on minor arc KJ, its measure is arc JH + arc HK = t + (2x − 27)°.
Equating these minor-arc measures gives 83 + t = t + 2x − 27. Cancel t to obtain 2x − 27 = 83.
Therefore 2x=110 and x=55. Only choice C satisfies the equation.
